noise: No 1/f, reference/supply, capacitor dielectric, PCB, notch-circuit noise or ADC alias noise. Densities are typical datasheet values, not guaranteed at 3.3 V. Not injected into waveforms; quantization remains separate.

noise_budget.method: uncorrelated white sources integrated over 20–450 Hz; ideal unity Sallen-Key buffers
noise_budget.exclusions: No 1/f, reference/supply, capacitor dielectric, PCB, notch-circuit noise or ADC alias noise. Densities are typical datasheet values, not guaranteed at 3.3 V. Not injected into waveforms; quantization remains separate.

tolerances.method: 200 seeded independent uniform R/C component draws; ideal buffers; notch omitted to isolate component effects
tolerances.limitations: Percentiles are sampling summaries, not worst-case guarantees. No internal gain errors, parasitics or finite op-amp response. Q changes with component mismatch.
